qaLog.question: Which problem should this feature solve first?
qaLog.answer: 1 and 2: long memory and smaller prompt

qaLog.question: Who writes the retrospective of a finished mesocycle?
qaLog.answer: A model call, once, with some stats computed by Stamind and optionally the athlete's own words

redTeamFindings.title: Nothing defines which finished mesocycles exist across plan versions
redTeamFindings.resolution: A record is created when the mesocycle ends, keyed by goal, name and start date. The cut-short case stays.

redTeamFindings.title: Written the morning after, from data that has not settled
The companion's sentence is written before the answer
redTeamFindings.resolution: The sentence is written by the same call, after the answer.

redTeamFindings.title: In expert mode the question is almost never asked
redTeamFindings.resolution: A date check in daily commands queues the question.

redTeamFindings.title: Horizon goals and re-dated goals
redTeamFindings.resolution: A retrospective is about the plan. One record per plan trained to its end.
redTeamFindings.answer: User: a changed goal date with an unadjusted plan is a user mistake; a retrospective is about the plan, not the goal. Then: yes, one per plan trained.

redTeamFindings.title: Which goals feed long memory, and goals called off
redTeamFindings.resolution: goal rm ends the plan that day.

redTeamFindings.title: Backfill and retries run model calls inside slow commands
redTeamFindings.resolution: One-off script, date check before the plan changes, one record per run, one day between retries.

redTeamFindings.title: The smaller prompt is not reached, and the same weeks are told twice
redTeamFindings.resolution: Keep both texts. Long memory is the goal.

redTeamFindings.title: The week planner reading a retrospective
The athlete's words cannot be undone
redTeamFindings.resolution: Own field; the operator can replace or clear them.

redTeamFindings.title: The operator has no view of what was written
redTeamFindings.resolution: plan show prints the records in expert mode.
